Employee Salary Management System (Demonstrating All OOP Pillars)
Problem Statement

Design a C++ program to manage employee salary details using all four pillars of Object-Oriented Programming:

Encapsulation

Abstraction

Inheritance

Polymorphism

The program must calculate salary differently for different employee types.

System Design
Abstract Base Class: Employee
🔒 Private Data Members (Encapsulation)

string name

int id

double baseSalary

Public Member Functions

Constructor to initialize data

double getBaseSalary()

string getName()

int getId()

Pure virtual function:

virtual double calculateSalary() = 0;

Virtual destructor

This ensures Abstraction.

Derived Classes (Inheritance)
FullTimeEmployee

Bonus = 20% of base salary

Final Salary = baseSalary + bonus

PartTimeEmployee

No bonus

Final Salary = baseSalary

Polymorphism

Use a base class pointer (Employee*)
Call calculateSalary() dynamically.

Input Format
type name id baseSalary

Where:

type = 1 → FullTimeEmployee

type = 2 → PartTimeEmployee

Output Format
Employee Name: <name>
Employee ID: <id>
Final Salary: <salary upto 2 decimal places>
